title: Outbound solution playbook visuals: onboarding artboards & screenshot exports
creator: Lena Park
description: Create a set of polished onboarding artboards and annotated screenshot exports derived from the current product UI for the Sales & Solutions playbook. These assets will be used in outbound decks, one-pagers, and demo scripts. Focus on clarity for value props (fast inference, routing controls, cost dashboard) and create variants for desktop, tablet, and mobile placements.
deliverables: Figma file with 6 annotated artboards (desktop hero, desktop flow, routing config, cost breakdown, dedicated capacity modal, private deployment summary)
High-resolution PNG exports for slide decks (3 sizes: 1400x788, 1200x675, 1080x608)
Keyline SVGs for hero components (redwood logo, routing diagram overlays)
Copy snippets and 2-line talking points per screenshot saved as text files
Accessibility checklist and alt text for each screenshot
Export-ready folder in Drive with naming convention: SALES_Onboard_<artboard>_<size>.png
acceptance_criteria: All artboards approved by PM and Solutions lead
Screenshots exported at specified resolutions with transparent overlays where required
Export folder populated with assets and a one-page README containing usage instructions
No sensitive customer data visible; all example rows use synthetic/demo data
Assets reviewed for color-contrast and readable typography for slide use
tasks: 01 - Audit current product UIs and select representative routes/features for demos
02 - Create Figma artboards and initial layout comps
03 - Work with PM to craft concise copy for each screen (value props + talking points)
04 - Produce annotated callouts and accessibility alt text
05 - Export PNG/SVG assets and verify pixel-perfect alignment
06 - Run design review with Solutions and Sales (collect feedback)
07 - Iterate based on feedback and finalize export folder in Drive
08 - Hand off to Growth for slide inclusion and to Engineering for any screenshot gating
screenshot_spec: Hero (desktop) - 1400x788 PNG @2x, include shadow and 24px margin on slides
Flow (desktop) - 1200x675 PNG, crop to focus on routing panel
Modal (dedicated capacity) - 1080x608 PNG with callout overlay as separate SVG
Mobile mock - 480x853 PNG, compress with high quality (80%)
SVG exports - icons and routing diagram flows, single-layer optimized
